name: Transylvanian Saxons (Romania)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over red, charged at the centre with the shield of the Transylvanian Saxons — seven golden castles on a field parted blue and red.
history: The seven castles (Siebenbürgen) are the traditional emblem of the Transylvanian Saxons, the German community settled in Transylvania from the 12th century.

features.role: seven castles of the Transylvanian Saxons
